No explicit effect-specific replication-success verdict located for this ancillary outcome; significance was not used to infer reported_success. Attention p bound is printed as p < 001 in the full HTML; retained literal value 001 without inserting a decimal.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only extraction from the published article; title, authors and DOI match the assigned reference. PDF page 5 (printed p. 400) was rendered and visually checked. Canonical-text quotes retain the supplied parse glyphs: ¼ represents the rendered equals sign and gp2 represents rendered partial eta-squared. Numeric meanings and F degrees of freedom were verified on the rendered page. No conversion performed. Requested t is not printed for this Study 3 attention comparison; the paper prints F(1, 75) = 4.95, which is retained as printed. The unassigned replication and reported_success fields are placeholders and were not examined.
